user_input: What are the steps for manual promotion during a Ledger DB failover?
reference: Per SOP-OPS-014 section 3.2: (1) put the Payment Gateway and Billing Service into maintenance mode to freeze writes; (2) confirm the replica lag is under 5 seconds; (3) run `ledgerctl promote --replica ledger-db-replica-1`; (4) repoint the DNS record ledger-db.internal to the new primary; (5) run the ledger smoke test; (6) take the Payment Gateway and Billing Service out of maintenance mode.
reference_contexts: Put the Payment Gateway and Billing Service into maintenance mode to freeze writes.
Confirm that the replica lag is under 5 seconds.
Run the command ledgerctl promote --replica ledger-db-replica-1 to promote the designated replica as the new primary.
Repoint the DNS record ledger-db.internal to the new primary to ensure services can access the updated database instance.
Run the ledger smoke test to validate the functionality and stability of the new primary.
Take the Payment Gateway and Billing Service out of maintenance mode to resume normal operations.

Ensure that the old and new keys overlap for a 24-hour dual-key window before the old key is revoked.
